allowedDifferences: Original HTML/Markdown archived byte-for-byte in archive/html and archive/md; archive/ is intentionally ignored by Git.
Native MDX elements retain all original structure, classes, IDs and content; inner main becomes div.main to avoid nested app main landmarks.
Local lucide SVG icons replace external icon fonts.
No source scripts or external icon fonts execute in the migrated page.
React drawer adds focus trap, Escape, hash/scroll tracking and focus restoration; original 1100px breakpoint retained.
Mermaid base theme applies original colors under strict security with per-render configuration; all 18 definitions retained verbatim.
Intrinsic SVG sizing with block scroll containers centers small diagrams and keeps wide diagrams reachable.
App header clearance adds 64px sidebar offset and 88px heading anchor margins.
Scoped reset restores source typography, pseudo bullets, decimal markers, source confidence tags and focus styles after Tailwind.
Diagram loading, retry, accessible text descriptions and noscript notes added.
Formatting-only whitespace and whitespace inside table structural elements removed for hydration safety.
Wide left-to-right definitions retain their original orientation and use horizontal scrolling instead of the original automatic top-down rerendering.
